definitions.L: log(Ibar^FR / Ibar^ABF) per seed (cross_cell.log_ratios: seeds with both arms finite and > 0)
definitions.R: exp(median over common seeds of [L_a - L_b]); R < 1: FR relatively better at lambda_a
definitions.ci95: percentile 95 % CI of the seed-bootstrap median (default_rng(20261010), cross_cell.contrast)
definitions.ci975: Holm-consistent CI of the first Holm step (m = 2), percentiles 1.25 / 98.75 of the same draws
definitions.p: two-sided percentile-bootstrap p with the +1 correction (cross_cell.bootstrap_p)
definitions.holm: E1 and E2 are separate families of size 2 (N 512, N 128), primary metric only
definitions.secondary: final_e_F, Ibar_Fp_stat, Ibar_TV_half: same construction, every row unadjusted
definitions.G_hi: upper end of the 95 % CI of the summary's paired G(Ibar_F) at (lambda, N)
definitions.decomposition: median log(Ibar_a / Ibar_b) per arm over the contrast's seeds
